title: Voltcore Arena
configurationSource: User-provided model label (Anthropic Opus 5.5) and reasoning effort (high). The model label is normalized as claude-opus-5.5. The actual runtime configuration was not independently available.

validation.syntax: Passed node --check on the single inline classic JavaScript.
validation.structure: Found one title, 2 canvases, 1 inline stylesheet, and one inline classic script. No external assets found in HTML resource attributes or inline CSS.
validation.browser: Passed a smoke test in the Codex browser through a local preview. The Enter the Arena screen appeared and gameplay started without console errors.
validation.render: Native WebGL arena, weapon and HUD confirmed visually in a gameplay screenshot.
validation.interactions: Verified movement input, weapon selection, the defeat screen, click to replay and R resetting the run to full health and zero frags.

mobileSupportNotes: Movement, jumping and weapon selection require desktop keyboard controls, with mouse aiming. The source has no on-screen touch controls. Physical phone gameplay was not tested.
